Question B-001-018-003.

Why the correct answer is right: Basic-only holders may use repeaters down to an output frequency of 29.500 MHz.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "29.700 MHz": 29.700 MHz is the top of the named low repeater-output segment, so using it as the lowest output frequency moves the lower edge upward.
- sourceIndex 2: "50 MHz": 50 MHz is above the 29.500 MHz repeater-output threshold and would skip the lower 10-metre repeater segment named by the bank.
- sourceIndex 3: "144 MHz": 144 MHz is the bottom of the 2-metre band, not the lowest repeater output frequency allowed to Basic-only holders in this item.
